set.rappels: Rappel the south side of each summit as you traverse, then a rappel descent from South Peak to the Blue Glacier that ends in a free-hanging rappel over the moat. No count of rappels or stations is published.
set.rappel_count_note: The first-ascent party describes climbing the north faces of the four summits and rappelling their south sides, then rappelling from South Peak to the Blue Glacier, but gives no count or rope length for any of it. Expect to find or build your own anchors on the granite, and check every one.
set.descent: Rappel the south side of each summit during the traverse; from South Peak, rappel to the Blue Glacier, finishing with a free-hanging rappel over the moat.
set.descent_text: The traverse climbs the north faces of the four Gunsight summits and rappels their south sides. From South Peak, a rappel descent leads to the Blue Glacier; the last rappel is free-hanging over a gaping moat onto the glacier, so look for the line that clears it. Check every rappel anchor on the granite thoroughly before trusting it. Parties often finish this descent in darkness. Allow 3-4 hours, depending on snow and crevasse conditions on the glacier.
